observations: Blind formula pass: SLES-led anionic cleansing base with betaine support.
Early dimethicone plus cationic guar and later amodimethicone creates a coherent silicone deposition architecture.
Multiple acids are present, but glycolic acid is late and no finished pH is disclosed.
Separate 200 ml olefin-sulfonate/no-silicone version is a material identity boundary, not merged.

This means no specialist scalp-comfort target, not that the product is unsuitable for every sensitive user.

counterSignals.observation: Generic gentle, dermatological, anti-dandruff, oil-control, hair-care, volume, shine or repair positioning is not by itself a scalp-comfort target under the approved gates.
counterSignals.inference: Sensitive-profile suitability is derived separately from cleansing strength, scalp oiliness, dandruff support and exposure preferences.

gateDiagnostics.weightDepositionLoad: Moderate-to-high for a shampoo because dimethicone is early and amodimethicone plus cationic guar are present.
gateDiagnostics.weightPersistence: Moderate; silicone deposition may persist depending on routine.
gateDiagnostics.weightResetCapacity: Moderate cleansing partly offsets deposition but does not remove weight risk.
gateDiagnostics.r3FormulaSignalNote: No bond-specific active or bond-repair route; glycolic-acid gloss wording is not bond repair evidence.

evidence.scopeNotes: Formula and public marketing/consumer-review evidence only; no controlled shampoo-only test with comparator was found.

claimAudit.support: Strong S1 silicone/cationic deposition route supports shine and smoothing.
claimAudit.limitation: No disclosed shampoo-only instrumental test; glycolic acid alone is not the main mechanism in this formula.

claimAudit.support: Betaine co-surfactants and rinse-off format support some mildness/weight balance.
claimAudit.limitation: SLES-led cleansing and silicone deposition counter both mildness and no-weight wording.

medicalBoundary.rationale: Rinse-off cosmetic shampoo; no dandruff, hair-loss, dermatitis or other medical treatment classification is made.
